title: People in Albania protest against a resort for the rich

paragraphs: People in Albania are very angry right now. They are protesting in the streets because a rich man wants to build luxury hotels on Sazan Island.
This man is Jared Kushner, the son-in-law of Donald Trump. He wants to spend a lot of money to change this beautiful, quiet island into a place for rich tourists.

The people living in Albania are upset because the government made this deal in secret. Nobody knew about it until they read it in the papers. Protesters are holding toy flamingos because they want to protect the wild birds and the clean water around the island. More than 200 types of birds live there, and people fear the big buildings will destroy their homes.

The government says people are wrong and the project will not destroy the island. Kushner also tried to build a hotel in Serbia, but the people there protested, the police found bad dealings, and he had to stop. Now, the people of Albania hope they can stop him too and save their nature.

words.d: very expensive, beautiful, and comfortable, made for rich people to enjoy
something you don’t say to anyone
a large pink bird with long thin legs and a long neck that lives near water

paragraphs: Many people in Albania are very angry. They are shouting in the streets. A rich man wants to build big hotels on a beautiful island. His name is Jared Kushner. He is part of Donald Trump’s family. Trump’s daughter is Kushner’s wife.

Kushner wants to change a quiet, green island into a place for rich people. The people in Albania are mad because the government does not say anything about it. People read about it in the papers. paragraphs: Lots of people in Albania are really angry and are protesting in the streets of their capital city. They are trying to stop a huge 1.6 billion dollar project on Sazan Island.
The project is led by an investment firm that belongs to Jared Kushner, the son-in-law of Donald Trump.  Kushner wants to build a luxury resort for rich tourists there.

Regular people and local politicians are upset because the government kept the whole deal a secret until they saw it in the newspapers. Protesters are carrying pictures of flamingos because the island is surrounded by beautiful wild nature and water where more than 200 kinds of birds live. People worry that building hotels and moving big machines there will have a severe impact on the island’s pristine ecosystems.

The prime minister claims the protesters are wrong; however, the state anti-corruption group has already started looking into the deal. People hope they can stop this project just like protesters in Serbia stopped Kushner’s plans to build a luxury hotel on the site of a former army headquarters destroyed by NATO bombings in 1999.

words.d: something that is hidden from other people and not told to the public
fresh, clean, and beautiful, looking like it has never been touched or damaged by humans
working to stop dishonest or illegal behavior by people in power, like government officials taking hidden money
